paper_title: TL;DR Too Long, Do Re-weighting for Effcient LLM Reasoning Compression
caption: Comparison of accuracy and generation length between Vanilla CoT and our method on four benchmark datasets (GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, AMC) using DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models. consistently reduces generation length while maintaining or improving accuracy across both 7B and 14B model scales.

model_annotations.English: The chart titled “DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B Generation Length Comparison” illustrates generation length (in words) for two methods across four benchmark datasets, shown as paired vertical bars per dataset. The horizontal axis contains the category labels GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC in that left-to-right order, while the vertical axis is labeled “Generation Length (words)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 up to roughly 8000+ with regularly spaced tick marks at about 1000-word intervals. A legend at the top identifies two series: “Vanilla CoT” shown in light pink and “TLDR (Ours)” shown in dark red. For GSM8K, the light-pink bar is labeled 554, and the adjacent dark-red bar reaches roughly 250–260 words with a red “-54%” annotation above it; for MATH500, the light-pink bar is labeled 2861 and the dark-red bar is around 1500–1600 words with a “-46%” annotation; for AIME, the light-pink bar is labeled 6820 and the dark-red bar is around 6300–6400 words with a “-7%” annotation; for AMC, the light-pink bar is labeled 4510 and the dark-red bar is around 3350–3400 words with a “-25%” annotation. The bars are grouped by dataset (two bars per group) rather than stacked, and the only explicit emphasis beyond color is the red percentage annotation placed above each TLDR bar; the category order does not appear to be sorted by value.
model_annotations.German: The chart titled “DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B Generation Length Comparison” illustrates generation length (in words) for two methods, “Vanilla CoT” and “TLDR (Ours),” across four benchmark datasets. The horizontal axis contains the categorical datasets GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC in that left-to-right order, while the vertical axis is labeled “Generation Length (words)” and uses a linear numeric scale ranging from 0 up to around 8500, with regularly spaced tick marks at roughly 1000-word intervals. For each dataset, two adjacent bars are shown: a light pink bar for Vanilla CoT and a darker red bar for TLDR (Ours), as indicated by the legend centered near the top of the plot. The Vanilla CoT bars have numeric labels above them: GSM8K is 554 words, MATH500 is 2861 words, AIME is 6820 words, and AMC is 4510 words. The TLDR (Ours) bars are slightly shorter in each group and have red percentage annotations near their tops indicating “-54%” for GSM8K (corresponding to roughly 255 words by the bar height), “-46%” for MATH500 (roughly 1550 words), “-7%” for AIME (roughly 6340 words), and “-25%” for AMC (roughly 3380 words). The bars are grouped by dataset rather than stacked, and no bars appear to be additionally emphasized beyond the consistent use of color and the percentage annotations on the TLDR bars.
